title: Joseph Stalin sends the first advisers to China in an effort to repair the economic damage brought on by years of civil war.
text: Joseph Vissarionovich Stalin was a Soviet politician and revolutionary who led the Soviet Union from the late 1920s until his death in 1953, holding the title of General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union from 1922 to 1952 and serving as the nation's premier from 1941 to 1953.
